name: Degree-Cut Identity Obfuscation
description: The condition for a triangle is disguised using the graph theory identity that the sum of degrees of a subset of vertices equals twice the number of internal edges plus the number of cut edges. By framing vertices as "components" and edges as "tests", the equation requires the sum of degrees to equal the cut size plus 6, which algebraically forces exactly 3 internal edges. Models that fail to derive this identity will attempt an O(n^3 * avg_degree) brute force and TLE.
